name: The Hartford — AARP Auto & Home Insurance Program
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public thehartford.com pages only (no sign-in, no form submitted). Customer Service Center page: pay 24/7 by EFT or credit card, enroll in automatic monthly payment, eDelivery email notifications, billing statements in documents. Express Bill Pay for Auto and Home (no login): policy number OR bill account number (examples 31 PH 123456 / 55 100 123456), mailing ZIP code and a confirmation email address. Service landing: Create Your Account / Log In; after registering you can pay bills automatically, sign up for paperless. Login page (account.thehartford.com) shows Email Address + Continue first, with 'Forgot Email?', 'Sign In With Passkey' and 'Register An Account' (two-step). Contact page: AARP Auto customer service 800-423-6789, AARP Home 800-423-0567 (M-F 8-9 ET, Sat 8-6 ET); non-AARP auto 877-896-9320, home 800-624-5578; Spanish 877-621-4981; general correspondence P.O. Box 14219, Lexington, KY 40512 (payments go to the remittance address on the bill). Installment/EFT fees vary by state and the current amounts are not on the public pages reviewed (a dated EFT form PDF mentions $2 per withdrawal) so no fee is modelled. Express Pay confirmation-email field is not expressible in guestLookupFields. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): labels.forgot ('Forgot Email?') removed: that link recovers the sign-in email, while the fleet's forgot flow resets the password, so the family wording is kept. Public nav set from the Customer Service Center/contact pages (Log In, Register an Account, Express Bill Pay, Contact Us) so the captured header row ('ACCOUNT', a doubled logo name) no longer shows.

help.title: Pay your auto or home bill
paragraphs: Make a payment any time, 24/7, from your checking account (electronic funds transfer) or with a credit card after you log in.

No login? Use Express Bill Pay for Auto and Home. Have your policy number or bill account number ready and enter it without dashes or spaces, then give your mailing ZIP code and an email address for the confirmation.
AARP Auto Insurance Program customers can call 800-423-6789 and AARP Home customers 800-423-0567, Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. and Saturday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern.

help.title: Automatic monthly payment
paragraphs: Enroll in automatic monthly payment in your Auto & Home account so you never have to think about your bill or late fees.
Once you have registered, you can set up automatic payments, change vehicles and drivers, sign up for paperless and manage your policy documents in one place.

help.title: eDelivery and billing statements
paragraphs: With eDelivery you get an email whenever a new document or bill is ready instead of waiting for the mail.
You can view and print your auto and home documents online, including endorsements, Auto ID Cards, billing statements and correspondence.

help.title: Contact The Hartford
paragraphs: AARP Auto Insurance Program: 800-423-6789. AARP Home: 800-423-0567. Non-AARP auto: 877-896-9320; non-AARP home: 800-624-5578. Spanish: 877-621-4981.
General correspondence goes to AARP Insurance Program, The Hartford, P.O. Box 14219, Lexington, KY 40512. Send payments to the remittance address printed on your bill.

extra.intent: Find the customer service phone number The Hartford lists for AARP Auto Insurance Program customers. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
